column1: # The container matrix's known deviations (#1124): one row per x86_64 cell whose verdict is WRONG,
# fails on a held cell with no row (UNLISTED), a row whose verdict differs (CHANGED), a row whose cell
# now passes or traps (STALE: the fix deletes its own row), and a row naming no cell (UNKNOWN).
# A TRAP (the checked-failure `ud2`, rc 132) is a recorded outcome and has no row; any other signal, a
# timeout or a stray exit code is a CRASH and is held (#1277). The verdict holds a WRONG's check code, a
# CRASH's rc and only the kind of a refusal (its message carries absolute paths). Measured at #1604
# merged onto main ba74cc02 on omen, native x86_64, compiler built from this tree: 428 cells, OK=377
# WRONG=0 TRAP=3 CRASH=19 REFUSED=29. 48 rows under 7 open issues: 29 REFUSED (20 #1250, 8 #1280,
# 1 #1249) and 19 CRASH 139 (10 #987: `v[i]` and `v[a..b]` over a struct or enum element; 5 #1256: UFCS
# `v.at(i)`; 2 #1608: an `Option` element of `vec::iter`'s slice; 2 #1308: a grown OMap of `Option`
# values). The omap, oset, map, strmap, string and strbuf cells (#1278) add 3 of the rows. The 3
# TRAP 132 cells, hashmap.key.{i8,i64,enumN}, are all #1304: the structural hash's checked `u64(v)` of
